title: The architect decides meaning; the lead realizes and merges; the operator decides intent, priority and release
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Rights were stated around cuts: their scope, their branches and their integration.
decision: (1) The operator decides intent, priorities and release, and reviews where a story's risk calls for a person. A technical requirement of the operator's is its accepted decision and binds the lead; a technical recommendation is its open decision, which the lead settles. (2) The architect decides meaning only: concepts, stories, examples, meaning questions, and accepting a story done on its outcome; never how anything is built. (3) The lead decides realization: every technical decision, which it records, and merging approved pull requests that pass every check. Pushing to a project's shared repository follows that project's own convention.
consequences: The architect, lead, operator and decision rights concepts state this.
